coverageDisposition.note: 10 legacy tests/postgres-commit-adapter.test.mjs cases classified honestly below. NOT all 10 are directly covered by the surviving tests/postgres-unit-of-work-write-envelope.test.mjs; three were adapter-only behavior that has no surviving equivalent, and two are no longer separately asserted at all. Surviving-path key coverage (module export shape, IdempotencyConflictError shape, missing-tenantId pre-DB rejection, null-prototype/array/class/function payload-shape rejection, and the real-Postgres four-intent atomic commit + duplicate-fingerprint rollback) is retained; this is not a like-for-like 10/10 replacement.

mapping.legacy: the adapter module and its planning package exist
mapping.reason: asserted only that adapterPath was a string; PostgresCommitAdapter as a distinct exported surface is not re-tested. The surviving module's own export shape is separately proven by the export-shape test below, but that is a different module/surface, not a re-proof of this trivial assertion.

mapping.legacy: importing the adapter exposes PostgresCommitAdapter with no side effects
mapping.reason: PostgresCommitAdapter, COMMITTED_INTENTS and DEFERRED_INTENTS are adapter-specific exports with no equivalent assertion in the surviving file, which addresses createPostgresWrite/createPostgresUnitOfWork instead.

mapping.legacy: IdempotencyConflictError is exported, frozen, and carries a deterministic non-retryable shape
mapping.reason: re-proven verbatim by 'postgres-write-envelope-write.mjs directly exports IdempotencyConflictError, checkPreparedChangeSet, checkTenantId and isDuplicateIdempotencyFingerprintError with the deterministic, unchanged shape' (frozen constructor/prototype, code, retryable, tenantId, fingerprint, message).

mapping.legacy: the adapter refuses a preparedChangeSet that is not persistenceState pending
mapping.reason: the underlying behavior (rejecting a non-'pending' persistenceState) survives inside checkPreparedChangeSet's validation, but no surviving test exercises it directly: the checkPreparedChangeSet({persistenceState:'pending', intents:{}}) test at line 311 passes persistenceState='pending' and throws only because intents is empty. No surviving test passes a non-'pending' persistenceState and asserts rejection on that basis specifically.

mapping.legacy: the adapter refuses a customer intent with no tenantId, before any DB work
mapping.reason: re-proven by 'createPostgresWrite rejects a preparedChangeSet with a missing customer tenantId before ever calling scope.query', including the pre-DB-work guarantee (scope.query throws if called).

mapping.legacy: the adapter refuses a customer intent whose tenantId mismatches options.tenantId, before any DB work
mapping.reason: this specific cross-check (customer.tenantId vs. the options.tenantId passed to adapter.commit) was PostgresCommitAdapter-only. checkTenantId in the surviving file only validates a single tenantId value in isolation (empty/undefined -> TypeError); no surviving test compares two tenantId values against each other.

mapping.legacy: the adapter accepts a null-prototype customer.payload with a non-empty name, past shape checks and before any DB work
mapping.reason: re-proven by 'checkPreparedChangeSet accepts a null-prototype safe customer.payload and rejects array/class-instance/function payload shapes' (checkNullProto branch asserts checked.customer.payload.name === 'Ada').

mapping.legacy: the adapter still refuses a customer.payload with no name, whether ordinary or null-prototype
mapping.reason: no test in tests/postgres-unit-of-work-write-envelope.test.mjs constructs a customer.payload with an empty object or a nameless null-prototype object and asserts rejection. The surviving payload-shape test only exercises array/class-instance/function rejection and the null-proto-with-name acceptance case; the no-name rejection path is not independently exercised anywhere in the surviving suite.

mapping.legacy: the adapter still refuses a customer.payload that is an array, a class instance or a function
mapping.reason: re-proven by the rejectedShapes loop (array, class instance, function) in 'checkPreparedChangeSet accepts a null-prototype safe customer.payload and rejects array/class-instance/function payload shapes'.

mapping.legacy: all four ALLOW_COMMIT intents, including customer, are committed atomically against a real PostgreSQL 16 instance
mapping.reason: re-proven against a real Docker-backed PostgreSQL 16 instance by 'WriteEnvelope composed with createPostgresWrite over a real UnitOfWork commits all four intents in one tenant transaction and returns a canonical CommitReceipt' plus the duplicate-fingerprint rollback case in 'a repeated preparedChangeSet fingerprint through WriteEnvelope rejects with IdempotencyConflictError and leaves exactly one row per table'.

red.failingTest: the legacy tests/postgres-commit-adapter.test.mjs file must be absent
